name: io.github.theYahia/aprovodka
title: aprovodka
description: MCP server for 1C:Enterprise via OData 3.0 — catalogs & documents CRUD, post/unpost, registers & balances, accounting registers incl. virtual tables, constants, batch ops, change-tracking, metadata discovery, curated config presets. 34 tools. Basic auth.

environmentVariables.name: ONEC_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the 1C HTTP server (e.g. http://server:8080/base)

environmentVariables.name: ONEC_LOGIN
environmentVariables.description: 1C user login for HTTP Basic auth

environmentVariables.name: ONEC_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: 1C user password for HTTP Basic auth

environmentVariables.name: ONEC_SERVICES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated module list to register (default: all). Modules: catalogs, documents, registers, accounting, constants, shortcuts, reports, odata, batch, changes, meta

environmentVariables.name: ONEC_WRITE_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Write-safety gate: off (default, writes execute directly) | preview (dry-run only, nothing is written) | approval (each write needs a one-time approve_write)

environmentVariables.name: ONEC_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path to a JSONL audit ledger. Every gated write is appended before execution; if the file cannot be written the operation is refused (fail-closed)
